players.name: Rico Washington
players.note: Reached MLB with the Cardinals in April 2008, a brief callup (.158 in his only stint).

players.name: Joe Dillon
players.note: Reached MLB with the Marlins in 2005, then the Brewers (2007-08) and Rays (2009).

players.name: Jeremy Hill
players.note: Converted from catcher to pitcher and reached MLB with the Royals in 2002-2003.

players.name: Brandon Berger
players.note: Reached MLB as an outfielder with the Royals, 2001-2004, hitting 8 home runs and batting .212 for his career.

players.name: D.J. Carrasco
players.note: Went on to a 9-year MLB career (2003-2012) as a reliever for the Royals, White Sox, Pirates, Diamondbacks, and Mets - 24-21, 4.50 ERA, 315 strikeouts.

players.name: Rob Mackowiak
players.note: Played 8 MLB seasons (2001-2008) for the Pirates, White Sox, Padres, and Nationals as a versatile utility man - .259 average, 64 home runs, 286 RBI.

players.name: Dee Brown
players.note: Royals' 1996 first-round pick; played parts of seven MLB seasons for Kansas City and Oakland - .233 average, 14 home runs in 271 games.

players.name: Chris George
players.note: Royals first-round pick; pitched in MLB for Kansas City, 2001-2004 - 14-20, 6.48 ERA, 99 strikeouts as a left-handed starter.

players.name: Matt Murton
players.note: Named the Cape Cod League's 2001 MVP as Wareham won the league title. Reached MLB with the Cubs (2005 debut), Rockies, and Athletics, and later set Japan's NPB single-season hits record.

players.name: Aaron Hill
players.note: LSU product named the Cape Cod League's 2001 playoff MVP as Wareham won the title. Reached MLB with the Blue Jays, Diamondbacks, Brewers, Red Sox, and Giants.

players.name: Eric Reed
players.note: Reached MLB with the Marlins in 2006-2007.

players.name: Adam Greenberg
players.note: UNC product who became a well-known story: hit in the head in his only 2005 Cubs at-bat, then given a ceremonial one-at-bat contract by the Marlins in 2012.

players.name: David Bush
players.note: Wake Forest product who reached MLB with the Blue Jays (2004-05), Brewers (2006-10), and Rangers (2011), finishing 56-69 with a 4.73 ERA.

players.name: Drew Meyer
players.note: A 2002 Rangers first-round pick; reached MLB briefly with Texas in 2006, batting .214.

players.name: Mike McCoy
players.note: Reached MLB with the Rockies (2009) and Blue Jays (2010-2012), batting .190 in his career.

players.name: Luke Carlin
players.note: Northeastern product who reached MLB as a catcher for the Padres, Diamondbacks, and Indians (2008-2012), batting .179 with 3 home runs.

players.name: Rich Hill
players.note: Pitched a long MLB career into his mid-40s across 14 teams - 90-76, 4.02 ERA, 1,432 strikeouts. In a single 2017 start he lost both a perfect game (broken up by a 9th-inning error) and a no-hitter (broken up by an extra-innings walk-off homer) - the only pitcher in MLB history to do both in the same game.

players.name: Brad Ziegler
players.note: Became a submarine-style MLB reliever for the Athletics and others (2008-2018) - 37-38, 105 saves, 2.75 ERA. Opened his career with 39 consecutive scoreless innings, breaking a 101-year-old MLB record.

players.name: Chris Getz
players.note: MLB second baseman for the White Sox, Royals, and Blue Jays (2008-2014) - .250 average, 459 games; now VP/GM of the Chicago White Sox.

players.name: Jeff Frazier
players.note: Drafted by Detroit in 2004; played in MLB for the Tigers in 2010, batting .217 in 9 games. Older brother of two-time All-Star Todd Frazier.

players.name: Brian Bixler
players.note: MLB infielder for the Pirates, Astros, and Nationals (2008-2012) - .189 average, 183 games as a utility shortstop/outfielder.

players.name: Tommy Manzella
players.note: MLB shortstop for the Astros, 2009-2010 - .224 average, 83 games; debuted in September 2009.

players.name: Joey Votto
players.note: Went on to a legendary career with the Cincinnati Reds - .294 average, 356 home runs, 1,144 RBI, .411 on-base percentage. Won the 2010 NL MVP and Hank Aaron Award, made 6 All-Star teams, and became only the second Canadian ever to reach 2,000 hits, 300 home runs, and 1,000 RBI (after Larry Walker).

players.name: Luke Montz
players.note: Reached MLB with the Washington Nationals in September 2008.

players.name: Aníbal Sánchez
players.note: Led the 2004 Spinners' staff (1.77 ERA, league-leading 101 strikeouts) and went on to a long MLB career - 116-119, 4.06 ERA, 1,774 strikeouts, including a 2006 no-hitter and a 2013 AL ERA title (2.40); won the 2019 World Series with the Nationals.

players.name: Jim Henderson
players.note: Reached MLB with the Brewers, serving as their closer in 2013, and also pitched for the Mets - 10-11, 31 saves, 3.61 ERA; best season 2013 with a 2.70 ERA and 28 saves. Now the Brewers' minor-league pitching coordinator.

players.name: Kyle Seager
players.note: Played his entire MLB career (2011-2021) with the Seattle Mariners, making the All-Star team in 2014.

players.name: Brad Boxberger
players.note: Became an MLB closer, leading the AL with 41 saves for the Rays in 2015 (All-Star that year); pitched for seven MLB teams through 2023.

players.name: Adam Warren
players.note: UNC product who reached MLB with the Yankees (2012), Cubs (2016), Mariners, and Padres, finishing 30-24 with a 3.53 ERA.

players.name: Chris Dominguez
players.note: Tied the CCBL single-game home run record (3 in one game) in 2008; later reached MLB with the Giants and Reds (2014-15), going 7-for-40 (.175).

players.name: Curt Casali
players.note: Decade-long MLB catching career for the Rays, Reds, Giants, and Mariners, debuting with Tampa Bay in 2014.
